article_triage_ok_check.name: article_triage_ok_check
article_triage_ok_check.value:
"article_triage"."status" <> 'ok' or ("article_triage"."category" is not null and "article_triage"."region" is not null and "article_triage"."relevance" is not null
        and "article_triage"."impact" is not null and "article_triage"."why_en" is not null and "article_triage"."why_id" is not null
        and "article_triage"."why_en" <> '' and "article_triage"."why_id" <> '' and cardinality("article_triage"."themes") between 1 and 3)

opportunities_title_check.name: opportunities_title_check
opportunities_title_check.value: btrim("opportunities"."title_en") <> '' and char_length("opportunities"."title_en") <= 90 and btrim("opportunities"."title_id") <> '' and char_length("opportunities"."title_id") <= 90

opportunities_thesis_check.name: opportunities_thesis_check
opportunities_thesis_check.value: btrim("opportunities"."thesis_en") <> '' and char_length("opportunities"."thesis_en") <= 400 and btrim("opportunities"."thesis_id") <> '' and char_length("opportunities"."thesis_id") <= 400

opportunities_buyer_check.name: opportunities_buyer_check
opportunities_buyer_check.value: btrim("opportunities"."buyer_en") <> '' and char_length("opportunities"."buyer_en") <= 120 and btrim("opportunities"."buyer_id") <> '' and char_length("opportunities"."buyer_id") <= 120

opportunities_model_check.name: opportunities_model_check
opportunities_model_check.value: btrim("opportunities"."model_en") <> '' and char_length("opportunities"."model_en") <= 120 and btrim("opportunities"."model_id") <> '' and char_length("opportunities"."model_id") <= 120

opportunities_risks_check.name: opportunities_risks_check
opportunities_risks_check.value: cardinality("opportunities"."risks_en") between 2 and 5 and cardinality("opportunities"."risks_en") = cardinality("opportunities"."risks_id")

venture_market_factors_check.name: venture_market_factors_check
venture_market_factors_check.value: "venture_market"."factors" is null or coalesce(jsonb_typeof("venture_market"."factors") = 'object' and "venture_market"."factors" - array['demand', 'timing', 'competition', 'capital', 'regulatory']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof("venture_market"."factors"->'demand') = 'number' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'demand') ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'demand')::int <= 100 and jsonb_typeof("venture_market"."factors"->'timing') = 'number' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'timing') ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'timing')::int <= 100 and jsonb_typeof("venture_market"."factors"->'competition') = 'number' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'competition') ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'competition')::int <= 100 and jsonb_typeof("venture_market"."factors"->'capital') = 'number' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'capital') ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'capital')::int <= 100 and jsonb_typeof("venture_market"."factors"->'regulatory') = 'number' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'regulatory') ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' and ("venture_market"."factors"->>'regulatory')::int <= 100, false)

venture_winds_tailwind_check.name: venture_winds_tailwind_check
venture_winds_tailwind_check.value: ("venture_winds"."tailwind_en" is null and "venture_winds"."tailwind_id" is null) or ("venture_winds"."tailwind_en" is not null and "venture_winds"."tailwind_id" is not null and "venture_winds"."tailwind_en" <> '' and "venture_winds"."tailwind_id" <> '' and cardinality("venture_winds"."tailwind_article_ids") > 0)

venture_winds_headwind_check.name: venture_winds_headwind_check
venture_winds_headwind_check.value: ("venture_winds"."headwind_en" is null and "venture_winds"."headwind_id" is null) or ("venture_winds"."headwind_en" is not null and "venture_winds"."headwind_id" is not null and "venture_winds"."headwind_en" <> '' and "venture_winds"."headwind_id" <> '' and cardinality("venture_winds"."headwind_article_ids") > 0)
